CHAPTER 6 The Open Economy | 163 This equation shows that the nominal exchange rate depends on the real exchange rate and the price levels in the two countries. Given the value of the real exchange rate, if the domestic price level P rises, then the nominal exchange rate e will fall: because a dollar is worth less, a dollar will buy fewer yen. However, if the Japanese price level P∗ rises, then the nominal exchange rate will increase: because the yen is worth less, a dollar will buy more yen.
